app.title: Pre-Arrival Compliance Form
app.org: Deanship of Student Affairs • International Students Office
portal.name: Pre-Arrival Onboarding Portal
stepper.label: Form progress
login.heading: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your details exactly as they appear on your passport.
login.passport.hint: Letters and numbers only. Spaces are fine.
login.phone.hint: Include the country code, for example +966 55 123 4567.
login.name: Full name
error.passport: Enter 5–20 letters and numbers, as printed on your passport.
error.phone: Enter a phone number with its country code, for example +966 55 123 4567.
error.name: Enter your full name (2–100 letters) as it appears on your passport.
error.login: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your details and try again.
error.network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
terms.heading: Terms and responsibilities
terms.lead: Check each item to confirm you have read and agree to it.
terms.incomplete: Confirm all five terms to continue.
sign.heading: Sign the declaration
sign.tabs.label: How to sign
sign.draw.label: Signature area
sign.draw.hint: Sign with your finger, stylus or mouse. To use the keyboard instead, choose Upload.
sign.draw.short: That’s too short to be a signature. Sign again.
sign.upload.prompt: Drag an image of your signature here, or
sign.upload.hint: PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB.
sign.incomplete: Draw or upload your signature to continue.
error.sig.type: Upload a PNG or JPEG image.
error.sig.size: That image is larger than 2 MB. Choose a smaller file.
error.sig.empty: That file is empty. Choose another image.
error.sig.read: We couldn’t read that image. Try another file.
error.submit: We couldn’t submit your declaration. Your signature is still here. Try again.
receipt.heading: Declaration submitted
receipt.lead: We received your signed declaration. Keep this reference number.
receipt.privacy: Your details are not stored in this browser. Finishing clears them from this page.
error.sig.small: That image is too small to be a signature. Upload a larger photo.
error.sig.blank: That image looks blank. Upload a photo or scan with your signature in dark ink.
receipt.finishWarn: Clearing removes your declaration from this page. Print or save it first if you still need a copy.
